subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Eros and Thanatos
description: A quick win: understand Eros and Thanatos.

hook.text: Freud claimed two drives rule the mind: Eros pulls us toward life; Thanatos pulls toward death.

buildup.text: Greek myth placed Eros among the first gods. Thanatos was death personified, brother of Sleep.

discovery.text: Freud borrowed myth to name biology. He believed every organism seeks both creation and rest.

twist.text: Most psychologists rejected the death drive. But war and self-destruction keep asking why.

climax.text: Myth gave Freud language for something science couldn't name: the pull toward oblivion.

punchline.text: Two gods. One mind. Eternal tug-of-war.

quiz.question: What does Thanatos represent in Freudian theory?
